prisoners.name: Arturo Hermosillo
prisoners.description: Arturo Hermosillo is a Los Angeles electrician and U.S. citizen who recorded federal immigration agents in Pacoima on June 19, 2025, after seeing a neighborhood street vendor in distress. He said he accidentally backed his work van into another vehicle while trying to comply with instructions to move. Agents pulled him from the van and restrained him. He was held for several hours at a Department of Homeland Security building in downtown Los Angeles and released that day. Officials told him he was being investigated for interference; reporting on this detention states that he was released without charges.

cases.charges: Investigated for interfering with federal agents; released without charges in this June 19 detention
cases.sentence: No sentence documented for this detention. Held for several hours and released on June 19, 2025. Sources: https://sanfernandosun.com/2025/06/25/local-resident-recording-ice-activity-could-face-federal-charges/ ; https://www.rsn.org/001/documenting-ice-agents-brutal-use-of-force-in-la-immigration-raids.html (republished reporting by The Intercept, including a separate interview).
